display.purpose: Primary narrative headlines on log, map, and identification screens.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Warm action control for starting, confirming, or publishing a dive record.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>記錄一潛</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:#e69b55; color:#071b2d; padding:12px 17px; font:800 13px Manrope, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 8px 20px #0003; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#ffc383; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6fe0df; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined correction action used alongside a primary confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border:1px solid #628594; border-radius:9px; background:transparent; color:#d4eaec; padding:11px 15px; font:700 13px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#bce0df; color:#f4fbfc; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6fe0df; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Line Field
components.description: Transparent, underlined text field for editable dive facts.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">物種名稱<input value="玳瑁" aria-label="物種名稱"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#bce0df; font:500 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field input { border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #4c7180; background:transparent; color:#f1fbfb; padding:10px 0; outline:none; font:600 20px 'Playfair Display', serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#e69b55; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6fe0df; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Row
components.description: Fixed-rail navigation row with a visible aqua active edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { border:0; background:transparent; color:#80a7b5; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:13px; width:100%; padding:12px; border-radius:10px; text-align:left; font:400 14px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:.2s ease; } .ds-nav-row svg { width:19px; height:19px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-nav-row:hover, .ds-nav-row-active { color:#f4fbfc; background:#13374d; } .ds-nav-row-active { box-shadow:inset 2px 0 #6fe0df; } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6fe0df; outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-sighting-card { width:260px; background:#0a2237; color:#e9f3f6; transition:transform .25s ease, background .25s; overflow:hidden; } .ds-sighting-card:hover { transform:translateY(-5px); background:#0d2a41; } .ds-sighting-photo { height:180px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; } .ds-water { height:100%; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#164c68,#0a2237 70%); transition:transform .5s; } .ds-sighting-card:hover .ds-water { transform:scale(1.05); } .ds-sighting-photo span { position:absolute; left:10px; bottom:10px; background:#061a2edd; padding:6px 8px; font:500 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-sighting-copy { padding:15px 16px 18px; } .ds-sighting-copy p { margin:0 0 8px; color:#81a9b6; font:500 11px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-sighting-copy h3 { margin:0; font:600 20px 'Playfair Display', serif; } .ds-sighting-copy i { display:block; color:#87aeb9; margin:3px 0 18px; font:italic 13px 'Playfair Display', serif; } .ds-sighting-copy small { display:block; border-top:1px solid #284a5e; padding-top:11px; color:#b8d1d8; font:400 11px Manrope, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-meter { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; border-block:1px solid #31556a; padding:12px 0; color:#83a5af; font:500 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-meter > div { display:flex; gap:25px; } .ds-step { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; border:0; background:transparent; color:#547889; padding:0; font:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-step i { display:grid; place-items:center; width:19px; height:19px; border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:50%; font-style:normal; font-size:8px; } .ds-step:hover { color:#e8f4f5; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6fe0df; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-step.ds-active { color:#e8f4f5; } .ds-step.ds-active i { border-color:#e69b55; color:#e69b55; } .ds-step.ds-done { color:#a6d0cd; }

components.name: Map Pin
components.description: Pale pill marker for a recorded place on the map surface.
components.css: .ds-map-pin { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; border:0; border-radius:20px; background:#dcefee; color:#083047; padding:7px 10px; font:800 11px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-map-pin svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:#e16f4e; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-map-pin:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-map-pin:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6fe0df; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-map-pin:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

narrative.overview:
Pelagic combines an inky, instrument-like shell with an editorial record of underwater life. Large serif headlines and species names give photographs and memories a reflective cadence; compact monospaced labels supply the measured, logged quality of dates, depths, steps, and map metadata.

The interface is deliberately dark and spatially restrained. Deep blue surfaces, thin marine-blue rules, cropped photography, and a single coral action color keep the focus on the dive record. On narrow screens, the fixed rail becomes a translucent bottom navigation while the core hierarchy and warm action point remain intact.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ocean fieldwork atmosphere with a restrained editorial voice.
Serif-led narrative hierarchy paired with operational mono labels.
Flat tonal surfaces, fine dividers, and photographic evidence over decorative chrome.
Coral is the active/action signal; seafoam and aqua support confirmation and focus.

rules.name: The Coral Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral is reserved for an action, a state change, or a location/species marker; it does not become a general surface color.

rules.name: The Journal-and-Instrument Rule
rules.body: Use Playfair Display for the remembered encounter and DM Mono for the logged fact; keep utility controls in Manrope.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation, photography, and fine rules for resting depth; reserve shadows for an actionable or transient element.

dos: Do keep the inky ocean ground, layered blue surfaces, and thin marine dividers as the default material system.
Do put the remembered encounter in Playfair Display and the logged metadata in DM Mono.
Do use coral for calls to action and small status/marker moments, with seafoam/aqua for confirmation and focus.
Do preserve the implemented 800px mobile transition from fixed side rail to fixed blurred bottom navigation.
Do let real underwater photography carry the visual focal point, using the existing crop and overlay treatment for legible metadata.
donts: Don't apply rounded corners or shadows indiscriminately to cards and large surfaces; the implemented resting composition is mostly flat and square.
Don't turn muted metadata into primary body text; its compact mono hierarchy is intentional.
Don't use coral as a large background field or general decoration; it is an action signal.
Don't remove the visible aqua focus treatment from interactive controls.
